name: Flesinoxan
summary: Flesinoxan (developmental code name DU-29373) is a potent and selective 5-HT1A receptor partial or near-full agonist of the phenylpiperazine class. Originally developed as a potential antihypertensive drug, flesinoxan was later found to possess antidepressant and anxiolytic effects in animal tests.

pharmacology.text: Flesinoxan (developmental code name DU-29373) is a potent and selective 5-HT1A receptor partial or near-full agonist of the phenylpiperazine class.

uses.text: Originally developed as a potential antihypertensive drug, flesinoxan was later found to possess antidepressant and anxiolytic effects in animal tests. It was also developed for treatment of anxiety disorders. The drug reached phase 3 clinical trials for anxiety disorders.
